title: Senior Marketplace Analyst
description:
**About Stonehill Solutions**

Stonehill Solutions is a technology solutions company dedicated to building reliable, scalable, and intelligent digital systems that help businesses operate more efficiently, adapt faster, and grow with confidence.

Established on the trusted foundation Stonehill Solutions carries forward a legacy of excellence while building its own identity as a specialized technology and business solutions provider. We focus on delivering innovative, practical, and future-ready solutions that streamline operations, enhance productivity, and support sustainable business growth.

**Position overview**

We are looking for a Senior Marketplace Analyst to strengthen the forecasting, diagnostic and reporting systems behind our marketplace decisions. Working directly with the Director, Marketplace, Operations & Customer Experience, you will turn complex operating data into clear recommendations that improve capacity planning, service reliability and city performance.

This is a hands-on analytical role for someone who can move beyond reporting to explain what changed, why it has changed and what business should do next. You will work closely with Supply, Ground Operations, Customer Service, Product, Technology, Finance and Growth.

Ride-hailing experience is strongly preferred. We will also consider candidates from delivery, quick-commerce, last-mile logistics or other marketplaces where supply-demand balancing, field execution and real-time service levels are central to the business.

**Key responsibilities**

**Demand, supply and capacity planning**

* Build rolling demand and supply forecasts by city, product, day and hour.
* Translate demand forecasts, chauffeur churn and productivity into recruitment, activation and capacity requirements.
* Track forecast accuracy and improve models as seasonality, new products, events and city behavior change.
* Model the marketplace impact of B2B commitments, port work, scheduled services, promotions and Saudi launch requirements.

**Marketplace performance analysis**

* Monitor fulfilment, request-to-accept time, accept-to-arrival time, cancellations, unserved demand, active chauffeurs, online hours, utilisation, productivity and Customer Service performance.
* Diagnose performance by city, daypart, zone, service type, chauffeur cohort and customer segment.
* Identify anomalies, quantify the customer and commercial impact, and distinguish symptoms from root causes.
* Build clear action-oriented analyses for the Director and functional heads, including owners, expected impact and follow-up measurement.

**Operating reviews and decision support**

* Own the analytical preparation for daily controls, weekly business reviews and monthly operating reviews.
* Maintain one trusted set of marketplace definitions and challenge inconsistent or unreliable metrics.
* Automate recurring reports and alerts so time is spent on diagnosis and action rather than manual data preparation.
* Support scenario planning for city launches service-level trade-offs, supply incentives and operational investments.

**Cross-functional problem-solving**

* Work with Supply, Ground Operations and Customer Service to convert analysis into operating changes and measurable service recovery.
* Partner with Product and Technology on data quality, marketplace tooling and product changes affecting operational performance.
* Collaborate with Finance and Growth where marketplace decisions affect unit economics, pricing, promotions or capacity investment.

**Candidate profile**

* Four to seven years of experience in marketplace analytics, strategy and operations, business operations or operational planning.
* Ride-hailing experience is strongly preferred. Adjacent marketplace experience is acceptable when the operating model includes live supply-demand balancing and field execution.
* Advanced SQL and strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are mandatory.
* Strong working knowledge of Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, Looker or a comparable business-intelligence platform.
* Demonstrated experience building forecasts, capacity plans, cohort analyses and operational performance diagnostics.
* Ability to communicate complex analysis as a short, defensible recommendation for senior operators.
* Strong attention to definitions, data quality and detail, without losing sight of the commercial and customer outcome.
* Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the question may initially be unclear and the data may be imperfect.
* Python or statistical modelling experience is useful but not required.

Job Title: Asst. Manager - Information Technology
  
  
Job Requisitions No.: 19194
  
  
**Job Description**
**Purpose of Job**
We are looking for an experienced
**L3 System Engineer**
to manage, maintain, and enhance complex IT infrastructure. As a senior technical expert, he will handle escalated issues, design and implement advanced solutions, and lead critical IT projects. The ideal candidate will have in-depth technical expertise in system administration, cloud technologies, networking, and virtualization, along with strong leadership and troubleshooting skills.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilites**

* Design, deploy, and manage Azure virtual machines, storage, and networking.
* Ensure high availability and disaster recovery of virtualized workloads.
* Monitor and optimize cloud resources for performance, cost, and availability.
* Implement and maintain Azure Active Directory and hybrid identity solutions.
* Configure and monitor Azure Backup, Site Recovery, and security compliance policies.
* Manage and maintain the Active Directory Infrastructure, Perform Active Directory Infrastructure up gradation & L3 level troubleshooting skill.
* Manage the Windows Active Directory (AD) environment, including servers like DHCP, DNS, WSUS and other services.
* Manage and maintain Server/San Storage/ Backup VM Ware and Citrix Infrastructure
* Monitor server health daily and take appropriate actions as needed.
* Monitor daily backup activities and take action in case of failures or issues.
* Strong technical knowledge of email systems, Office 365, SFTP
* Proficiency in administering O365, including configuring and managing user accounts, distribution lists, and email policies.
* Manage & maintain Filer Server including shared folder creation, User permission.
* Provide IT assistance for L3 troubleshooting to other IT support teams.
* Manage user accounts and access controls to client data, and conduct advanced monitoring and Reporting related to Server & Network systems.
* Implement security measures to safeguard the server infrastructure.
* Perform regular system updates, patches, and backups.
* Monitor server performance and identify areas for optimization.
* Troubleshoot and promptly resolve server-related issues.
* Manage server resources, including storage, memory, and processing power.
* Scale server infrastructure to accommodate business growth.
* Plan for capacity and resource expansion.
* Maintain detailed records of server configurations, changes, and maintenance activities.
* Generate regular reports on server performance and security.
* Configure and manage Veeam Backup & Replication for critical systems.
* Perform regular backup jobs, restoration, replication, and disaster recovery testing.
* Monitor backup logs, resolve failures, and ensure data recovery readiness.
* Develop and implement backup strategies to meet RTO/RPO requirements.
* Excellent communication skills. Good attitude and willingness to learn is crucial requirement.

**Skill Required**

* Strong expertise in Azure Cloud, including IaaS, PaaS, and hybrid environments.
* In-depth knowledge of VMware vSphere, ESXi, and virtualization concepts.
* Experience with Veeam Backup & Replication setup and administration.
* Proficiency in Active Directory and Office 365 administration.
* Desired to have certifications in Azure,Vmware,Office365
* Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Qualification Required**
8-12 Yrs of Server and Cloud Administration Experience.
  
  
**Relevant professional / Educational background**
Bachelor’s degree in science, Information Technology, or Engineering in a related field.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a
**Senior Support Engineer**
, you will serve as the primary technical interface for enterprise customers, partners, and internal Oracle teams, providing expert technical support for Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and related Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) technologies. You will troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, provide guidance on product configuration and best practices, and help customers maximize the value of Oracle's cloud solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will support
**customers across different regions**
, requiring professional fluency in English. You will collaborate closely with Oracle Product Development, Cloud Operations, and global engineering teams to investigate product issues, identify root causes, validate fixes, and improve product quality and customer experience.
  
  
As a senior member of the Global Product Support organization, you will demonstrate deep technical expertise across Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and enterprise integration technologies. You will work independently on complex customer issues and critical customer escalations as needed.
  
  
This position requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to manage multiple high-priority customer issues with minimal supervision while consistently delivering exceptional customer support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a member of the Support organization, your focus is to deliver post-sales support and solutions to Oracle customers while serving as an advocate for customer needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide customer and system support for Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including Oracle Process Automation Cloud.
* Troubleshoot and analyze issues across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services, including Compute, Storage, Virtual Cloud Network (VCN), Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP), and Identity Domains.
* Collaborate with Oracle Fusion Applications, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and Product Development teams to investigate and resolve customer issues.
* Provide technical support for Oracle Integration Cloud customers across global regions.
* Work directly with customers, delivering technical troubleshooting, issue analysis, and resolution through phone, web, and electronic support channels.
* Collaborate with global engineering, development, and support teams to resolve complex technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Identify, reproduce, document, and escalate product defects while working closely with Development to drive timely resolution.
* Review internal knowledge articles, technical documentation, and external publications, providing feedback to improve product quality, documentation, and overall customer experience.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and best practices to improve support efficiency.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
